newsitem.title: USA: Duke 1,129 MW S.C. nuke boosting power. [CORRECTED 14:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Duke 1,129 MW S.C. nuke boosting power. [CORRECTED 14:30 GMT]

text.p: Duke Power Co's 1,129 megawatt (MW) Catawba nuclear power unit 1 was operating at 87 percent of capacity and ramping up to full power as of early Tuesday (corrects day), the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, in Clover, S.C., was "increasing power to 100 percent," the NRC said Monday in its daily plant status report.
Catawba 1 was taken off line late Thursday due to a leak in a small reactor coolant pump. The unit resumed power output over the weekend.
The adjacent 1,129 MW Catawba nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full capacity as of early Tuesday (corrects day), the NRC said in the report.
